question: Should this internal refactor wait for current-head source-checkout and built-package import proof, or should the existing older-head Testbox evidence receive a maintainer proof override?
rationale: The code change is internal and appears sound, but the current head contains package-resolution fixes not covered by the PR body's exact-head evidence, so accepting the existing proof requires explicit maintainer judgment.

options.title: Require current-head import proof

options.title: Approve a proof override
options.body: Accept the older-head Testbox build and focused tests as sufficient for this internal-only refactor and let current-head CI gate the remaining package changes.
